name: Webform Campaign Monitor
description: Provides a Webform handler that subscribes a submitter to a Campaign Monitor list on form submission, delegating the API call to the campaignmonitor module.
project_description:
Webform Campaign Monitor provides a Webform handler that subscribes users to specific lists on Campaign Monitor ( http://www.campaignmonitor.com/ ) when a form is submitted.

With Webform Campaign Monitor you can:

 Subscribe users to a Campaign Monitor list from any webform. 
 Map an email field and a merge-vars YAML block (including custom fields) to the subscriber record. 
 Gate the subscription behind an optional control checkbox so users must opt in. 
 Choose single or double opt-in per handler. 

The module is a thin bridge: it collects handler configuration on the webform and, on submission, calls the campaignmonitor module's subscription manager, which performs the actual Campaign Monitor API request using the createsend-php library and the API key/client ID configured in the campaignmonitor module.
